procedure_text: 0.10 g (0.23 mmol) 3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chlor-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoat, 1 Tropfen Acetoncyanhydrin und 0.04 g (0.39 mMol) Triethylamin wurden in 5 ml Acetonitril gelöst und über Nacht bei Raumtemperatur gerührt. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer eingeengt, mit 5 ml Wasser versetzt und mit 5 M HCl sauer gestellt. Es wurde mit Essigester extrahiert, mit Wasser gewaschen, über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt. procedure_summary: The enol ester is rearranged to the C-acylated dione in acetonitrile at room temperature with triethylamine and a catalytic drop of acetone cyanohydrin. The mixture is concentrated, diluted with water, acidified with hydrochloric acid, extracted with ethyl acetate, washed, dried over magnesium sulfate and concentrated to the title compound as a colourless oil.

The transformation is an intramolecular O-to-C acyl migration: substrate and product are isomers of the same formula C21H25ClO6S, which is the clearest evidence that this is a rearrangement rather than a coupling, and it is why the stated yield can reach 100 % of theory. reaction_class is recorded as acylation with medium confidence because the closed class list has no rearrangement value; the rearrangement character is carried in tags as transformation:rearrangement. named_reaction is null: this base-promoted acyl migration resembles a Fries rearrangement in outcome but is not the Lewis-acid Fries reaction and has no widely accepted name, so none is stretched onto it.
